app.name: Pomodoro
app.summary: A focus timer: 25 minutes of work, a short break, and a long break after every fourth round.
app.part_sound_hint: Three beeps at the end of every phase, on a screen with a speaker. Follows the screen's volume.
app.setting_focus_hint: How long a focus round lasts, 1 to 90 minutes. Default 25.
app.setting_short_hint: The break after a focus round, 1 to 30 minutes. Default 5.
app.setting_long_hint: The break after the last round of a cycle, 1 to 60 minutes. Default 15.
app.setting_rounds_hint: How many focus rounds make a cycle, 2 to 8. Default 4.
app.setting_autostart: Start the next phase by itself
app.setting_autostart_hint: Off: when a phase ends the pomodoro waits for a tap on Start. On: the next phase starts at once.
app.setting_opens_hint: A popup over whatever the screen shows when a phase ends, with Start for the next one.
app.setting_sound_hint: The beeps when a phase ends, on a screen with a speaker.
